stem: What is the most likely reason the author uses the simile “like an arrow”?
instruction:
Read this sentence from paragraph 10.

Those with short legs, like froghoppers, store muscle energy in their body to shoot themselves into the air, much like an arrow.

options.label: A
options.text: To describe how froghoppers are shaped

options.label: B
options.text: To show how strong froghoppers must be to jump

options.label: C
options.text: To explain how long it takes froghoppers to land

options.label: D
options.text: To highlight how far froghoppers move when they jump
